title: Access beyond membership or role
failure_mode: A user reads or changes records in a project they are not a member of, or beyond their role.
effect: Loss of record integrity and confidentiality.
mitigation: Row Level Security on every table; automated negative tests for every role, including direct API calls.

title: Audit trail altered or bypassed
failure_mode: An audit entry is modified, deleted, or a change is made without an audit entry.
effect: Record history can no longer be trusted.
mitigation: Database triggers write audit entries; update and delete revoked on the audit table for all roles; tests attempt both as admin.

title: Signature appears to cover changed content
failure_mode: A signature appears to apply to content that changed after signing.
mitigation: Signatures store the item version; UI marks mismatches; automated test edits a signed item and checks the signature is shown as not applying.

title: Approved item edited in place
failure_mode: An approved item is edited in place without a new version.
mitigation: Database rule blocks updates to approved versions; tests attempt edits through UI and API.

title: Author approves own work
failure_mode: The author approves their own work.
mitigation: Signature check compares signer with version author; automated test.

title: Changed script keeps its approval
failure_mode: An automated test script changes after approval and its results still count as formal evidence.
effect: Evidence comes from an unreviewed script.
mitigation: SHA recorded at approval and compared on every result; automated drift test.

title: Results attached to the wrong test case
failure_mode: Automated results are attached to the wrong test case or posted by an unauthorized caller.
mitigation: API key per project; strict ID matching; rejected results logged; tests for unknown IDs and bad keys.

title: Dry run counted as formal evidence
failure_mode: A dry run is counted as formal evidence.
mitigation: Run type set by the system from approval state, never by the user; automated tests for both cases.

title: Trace matrix overstates coverage
failure_mode: The trace matrix shows a requirement as covered when it is not.
effect: Release decision made on false coverage.
mitigation: Coverage rules computed in the database; tests for each uncovered condition (no run, failed run, unreviewed run, open deviation).

title: Release baseline changes
failure_mode: A release baseline changes after it is created.
effect: The validated release no longer matches its evidence.
mitigation: Baseline rows insert-only; automated test attempts modification.

title: Import creates duplicate or malformed items
failure_mode: CSV import creates duplicate or malformed items.
mitigation: Preview with validation before commit; whole import in one transaction; tests with bad files.

title: Unattended session used by someone else
failure_mode: An unattended session is used by another person.
effect: Actions attributed to the wrong user.
mitigation: Automatic sign-out after inactivity; re-authentication at signing.

title: Ambiguous or wrong time zone
failure_mode: Timestamps are shown in an ambiguous or wrong time zone.
mitigation: Store UTC; display with time zone; tests across time zones.

title: Pass recorded without real comparison
failure_mode: A tester selects Pass without really comparing, and the filled-in actual result is taken as observed.
effect: A step is recorded as passed without real verification.
mitigation: Fill in only on an explicit Pass and only when the actual result is blank; mark it as filled in from the expected result; clear it automatically on Fail; executor signature attests to the run; reviewer checks evidence.

title: Evidence missing or attached to the wrong run
failure_mode: A required value or evidence file is missing or attached to the wrong run.
effect: Objective evidence cannot support the result.
mitigation: Documentation steps cannot be recorded until every value is entered; evidence is stored with the run and listed in the signature summary; reviewer signature required.

title: Link changed without a trace
failure_mode: A link between items is added, removed or pointed at the wrong item without the change showing in the item's versions and history.
mitigation: Links are checked in the database (same project, allowed tracker types, no duplicates); a link change creates a new version of the item it belongs to and an audit entry; locked items cannot change their links; automated tests.
